name: Blinkit
shortInfo: Blinkit Commerce Private Limited, formerly Grofers, is an Indian quick-commerce service.
brief: Blinkit is **India's largest and most convenient hyper-local delivery company**, which enables you to order grocery, fruits & vegetables, and other daily essential products, directly via your mobile or web browser.

[Invoice](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/blinkit/pipelines/invoice.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the invoices for the specified period.

[Sales Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/blinkit/pipelines/sales-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the sales report for the specified period.

[Score Card Details](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/blinkit/pipelines/score-card-details.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the manufacturer’s score card details for the specified period.

[Score Card Top 5 Potential Loss](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/blinkit/pipelines/score-card-top-5-potential-loss.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the manufacturer’s score card details for the top 5 potential loss makers, for the specified period.

[Stock on Hand](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/blinkit/pipelines/stock-on-hand.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the current stock levels on hand.
